changes: explicit JSON schema and complete skill grammar
RGB-D top-surface to calibrated current-tool TCP mapping
fixed_scene_acceptance: Existing T3 S01 cold + 3 warm calls: every real dual-image call must have strict contract, correct target/destination instances, calibrated RGB-D top-grasp evidence and matching GPU model. Same-layout calls measure repeatability and latency, not independent task success.

independent_development_validation.all_cases_pass_definition: 12 positive strict and geometrically grounded correct-instance decisions plus 4 explicit refusals for absent purple target
independent_development_validation.role: Additional independent development validation; report all failures and all_cases_pass without converting it to a formal G1 success rate. No percentage threshold is invented after observing outcomes.

geometry_scope: Upright rigid boxes 0.05..0.10 m tall on measured horizontal support, current MJCF gripper in top-down orientation; 3x3 top patch span <=0.008 m and estimated fingertip clearance >=0.002 m. Unknown shape/occlusion or unsupported geometry requires further observation.
data_isolation: No offline instance masks, object poses, scene IDs or labeled candidate coordinates enter VLM requests. Instance masks and geometry are used only after responses for offline evaluation.
